_meta.source: Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) – Philippines
_meta.description: Business name dataset structured for use with DTI business-name information. This file is a reference dataset. Replace or supplement the 'companies' array with verified data from an official DTI export or the DTI Business Name Registration System (BNRS) at https://bnrs.dti.gov.ph before going to production.
_meta.disclaimer: The entries below are representative DTI-style business names for reference purposes. They do NOT certify that these names are currently active or officially registered unless verified against official DTI records. Names marked as popular are well-known Philippine SME/franchise-style business names recognized in commerce.
_meta.howToUpdate: Export business name records from the DTI BNRS portal (https://bnrs.dti.gov.ph) or request a dataset from DTI. Map each record to the schema: { id: number, name: string }.
_meta.note: If a user enters a name that exactly matches an entry in this list, it is flagged as already registered and submission is blocked.
